subject: MedNova security kickoff — SOC2 / BAA / hosting options (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <security@mednova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: MedNova security kickoff — SOC2 / BAA / hosting options (post-call recap)

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our call: 

- Ask summary: MedNova needs clarity on SOC 2 posture, ability to sign a BAA, and which Redwood hosting modes are eligible for PHI (and for de-identified data).
- What we confirmed on the call: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy attached), and we support three hosting modes: Hosted API (fastest onboarding, not approved for customer PHI), Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity, can be covered by a BAA for PHI workflows), and Private (VPC/on-prem options for regulated PHI and strict residency).
- Action items we committed to: 
  1) Share redacted SOC2 Type II evidence (attached).
  2) Send a draft BAA for MedNova review (attached).
  3) Fill out your vendor security questionnaire — we will return answers + evidence (Vendor_SQ-answers.xlsx).
  4) Confirm whether MedNova plans to send PHI (e.g., patient identifiers, full PHI payloads) or only de-identified datasets for initial POC — this will determine hosting recommendation.

Tentative timeline: we can get the SOC2 redacted file and questionnaire answers over the next 3 business days; draft BAA within 5 business days. If MedNova confirms PHI use, we recommend Dedicated or Private to start. 

Next step: Jordan, if you can confirm the PHI vs de-identified intention and preferred timeline, we’ll prioritize the BAA and questionnaire response accordingly. 

Thanks —
Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf, SOC2-TypeII-Report-redacted.pdf, Draft_BAA_template.docx
From: Jordan Ellis <security@mednova.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@mednova.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 18:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedNova security kickoff — SOC2 / BAA / hosting options (post-call recap)

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Deliverables we need: SOC2 Type II (redacted is fine), completed vendor security questionnaire (we'll attach our standard form in a follow-up), and a BAA template we can review.
- Residency: MedNova must keep PHI within US-based infrastructure for our initial deployment.
- PHI scope: For the POC we expect to ingest patient identifiers and clinical notes (so this is considered PHI). That means Hosted API (multi-tenant) is not an option for PHI. Please confirm if Dedicated with a signed BAA is considered acceptable and whether Private (VPC) is available under the same terms.
- Questions: 
  • Can Redwood Dedicated guarantee single-tenant GPU pools with encryption at rest and in transit (KMS integration)? 
  • For the SOC2 report you provided, what is the reporting period and which trust services criteria were covered? 
  • Are there any additional controls around data deletion/retention we should be aware of for PHI?

Timeline: We need the vendor questionnaire answers and a draft BAA in two weeks to align with our procurement window. If you can meet that, we’ll schedule a legal review call the week after.

Jordan Ellis
Head of InfoSec
MedNova Health
security@mednova.com

On Fri, Mar 9, 2028 at 2:02 PM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (call recap)…

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MedNova security — SOC2 / BAA / Qs

Forwarding Jordan's note — planning response below.

Team — proposed internal plan (high level):
1) SOC2: attach redacted SOC2 Type II (report we shared covers period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31; Trust Services Criteria: Security, Availability, Confidentiality). Rishi, please confirm if you want any additional redactions besides org identifiers.
2) Hosting recommendation: state explicitly that Hosted API is for non-PHI only; Dedicated and Private are eligible for PHI with a signed BAA. Dedicated provides single-tenant reserved capacity and supports KMS integration (customer-managed keys), encryption at rest/in transit, and audit logging. Private provides full VPC control and on-prem packaging if required.
3) Vendor questionnaire: I will map our controls to their questions and attach Vendor_SQ-answers.xlsx. We should mark any answers that require Legal review.
4) BAA: attach Draft_BAA_template.docx and propose DocuSign for signature.
5) Timeline: target 10 business days for questionnaire + SOC2 + draft BAA (we can push faster if Legal prioritizes).

I will prepare the questionnaire answers and the BAA redline suggestions. Grace — can you validate the tech controls language around KMS and deletion/retention? Rishi — can you confirm whether we should propose Dedicated vs Private as the default for MedNova?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
